Welcome. Have you ever felt caught between what you want to do and what you actually get done? Between the things that shout for your attention and the ones that really matter? If that sounds familiar, you’re definitely not alone—and you’re in exactly the right place.
Together, we’re about to explore the ideas at the heart of Life Strategies: Doing What Works, Doing What Matters—a powerful guide crafted by Phillip C. McGraw. This journey isn’t about lofty theories or wishful thinking. Instead, it’s about facing those everyday habits and patterns that can either help us move forward or quietly hold us back.
We’ll dig into what it really takes to close that gap between intention and action. You’ll find yourself looking at the choices you make, the moments when excuses sneak in, and what happens when you swap passive hope for bold, strategic steps. The honest truth? Change comes from clarity, accountability, and a willingness to see yourself—flaws and all—with open eyes.
Along the way, you’ll hear stories that feel all too real, and you’ll be challenged—sometimes gently, sometimes directly—to see what’s possible if you commit to doing what truly works and what genuinely matters. So, let’s step into this together. As we peel back the layers of daily decision-making, you’ll discover not just new strategies, but a fresh way of approaching life—one intentional choice at a time.
